newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Siderar started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Siderar started as buy.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said it had started coverage of Argentina's Siderar with a rating of buy.
-- CS First Boston said in a report that it assigned the rating "given (Siderar's) attractive valuation relative to its peers and its strong operating cash flow.

-- "Siderar is in an excellent position to capitalize on robust growth forecast for domestic auto and appliance sectors. Management is focused on reducing production costs and expanding Mercosur contacts," it said.
